# Markdown Preview Fold sample

Open this file, then run "Markdown: Open Preview to the Side". Hover a heading to see its caret.

## Setup

Install the dependencies and build once.

### Install

```bash
pnpm install
```

### Build

```bash
pnpm build
```

## Usage

- Click a caret to fold or unfold a section.
- Alt+click (Option+click on macOS) folds or unfolds all subsections too.
- Jump to [Install](#install) from here: the link opens its folded parents.

### Commands

Collapse All and Expand All live in the preview's title bar.
